evidence_role: corrected post-open resource gate after the v62 algebra PASS and the aborted v62 timing diagnostic; no PoolFire truth, validation, fresh trajectory, test trajectory, calibrated camera, curved ray, learned correction, or real BOST is read

aborted_parent_resource_diagnostic.primary_reason: The v62 resource controller compared cross-arm field and residual norm sequences instead of the full output vectors.
additional_reasons: The 102 jobs were globally shuffled rather than executed as adjacent randomized complete blocks.
The aggregation validator reported formal-versus-recomputed differences without enforcing equality.
The execution scripts, environment, and Git commit were not sealed across the batch.

The invalid v62 timing diagnostic completed 55 of 102 globally shuffled workers before audit termination.
At least one 101-call analytic-factor worker showed timed compute 4.294829042162746 seconds and at least one 101-call Zero-CGLS worker showed 21.339001582935452 seconds.
No complete v62 paired p50, p90, worst, final status, or independent resource validation existed.
Independent red-team review had already identified the norm-only compatibility flaw, non-adjacent pairing, unenforced validator differences, and unsealed execution closure.
v62_1_changes_frozen_after_audit: The algebra implementation, grid, detector, angles, observations, K4 algorithms, call ledgers, 17 repetitions, 5-call workload, 101-call workload, and all numeric pass thresholds remain unchanged.
A separate untimed three-worker batch now saves full field and residual arrays for all five unique observations and requires per-observation relative-L2 at or below 1e-10.
The 102 timing workers now execute as 34 adjacent randomized complete blocks with balanced within-block arm positions.
An execution release binds protocol, core, worker, controller, validator, Git HEAD, Python executables, numeric versions, and thread settings before the first worker.
The independent script is explicitly an aggregation audit, enforces all formal differences at or below 1e-15, and does not claim independent timing replication.

The execution closure is unchanged before, during, and after the batch.
The primary 101-call compute, outer-wall p50, outer-wall p90, worker-self RSS, and sampled process-tree RSS gates all pass.
